releases.notes:
**Full Changelog**: [Here](https://github.com/AzusaKe/Halo/compare/v2.5.1-fabric-1.21.1-adapter.1...v2.6.0-fabric-1.21.1-adapter.1)

---

- Added optional Flashback and ReplayMod compatibility for **Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric**, using one shared API v2 replay contract and recording track. Record effective equipment, startup/shutdown progress and the scepter's actual open/close lifecycle.
- Playback and offline export advance animation/physics by recording source time, including speed changes, independently of real rendering time. Paused sources and repeated views stay stationary; seeks restore relative progress and rebuild physics at the target anchor.
- Added ReplayMod Full/Quick indexing and marker-baseline rewriting, plus Flashback snapshot and output-frame hooks. Playback isolates local ownership/C2S writes; export suppresses Halo's interactive UI.
- Fixed periodic Halo snapping/resetting in ReplayMod playback and export when passing full checkpoints. Continuous playback now retains physical inertia; seeks and missing-event recovery still restore snapshots. Existing recordings containing the Halo track can be reused. Older recordings lack a complete initial state/UI track and retain best-effort behavior.
- Pinned HaloCore to **2.6.0 / 03f84db5**, adapter revision **1**. Existing halo definitions, saves, online packets and API v2 signatures remain compatible. Players install only the Halo mod JAR; recorder mods are optional and not bundled.
- All **364 core tests passed**. Local adapter checks covered **136 tests: 135 passed, 1 external YSM-fixture check skipped**, including actual ABI checks against ReplayMod **1.21-2.6.28** and Flashback **0.39.10** separately. The maintainer confirmed the snap fix and no further observed anomalies. Unreported trimming, multiview, shader and other mod combinations are not claimed as fully validated; 1.20.1 shared integration is committed separately without a release.

Requires **Java 21** or newer and Fabric API for **Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric**. Built with Fabric Loader 0.16.14 / Fabric API 0.116.15+1.21.1; isolated production startup checks used Fabric Loader 0.19.3. Test the two recorder mods separately.

---

- 为 **Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric** 添加可选 Flashback 与 ReplayMod 兼容，两个后端共用 API v2 回放契约及录像轨道，记录最终佩戴、启动/关闭进度和权杖实际开关。
- 普通回放与离线导出都按录像源时间推进动画和物理，随录像倍速变化且独立于实际渲染耗时；暂停及同帧重复视角不额外推进，跳转恢复相对进度并在目标锚点重建物理。
- 接入 ReplayMod Full/Quick 索引和 marker 起点快照重写，以及 Flashback 快照/输出帧边界。回放隔离本地恢复和 C2S 写回，导出抑制 Halo 交互界面。
- 修复 ReplayMod 回放/导出经过周期完整快照时光环 snap 或复位：连续播放保留物理惯性，跳转和缺失事件补齐仍恢复快照。已有 Halo 轨道的录像无需重录；旧录像缺少完整初始状态/UI 轨道，仍只能尽力回放。
- 固定 HaloCore **2.6.0 / 03f84db5**，适配修订为 **1**。既有定义、存档、在线数据包及 API v2 签名保持兼容。玩家只安装 Halo 模组成品；回放模组可选且不内嵌。
- **364 项 core 测试通过**；本地适配器共 **136 项，135 通过、1 项外部 YSM 测试包检查跳过**，包含分别针对 ReplayMod **1.21-2.6.28** 和 Flashback **0.39.10** 官方 JAR 实际运行的 ABI 检查。维护者确认 snap 消失且未观察到其它异常；未逐项报告的裁剪、多视角、光影及其它模组组合不扩大声明。1.20.1 只另行保存共享接入提交，不发布成品。

需要 **Java 21** 或更高版本，以及适用于 **Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric** 的 Fabric API。构建使用 Fabric Loader 0.16.14 / Fabric API 0.116.15+1.21.1；隔离成品启动检查使用 Fabric Loader 0.19.3。两个回放模组分别测试。

releases.notes:
**Full Changelog**: [Here](https://github.com/AzusaKe/Halo/compare/v2.5.0-neoforge-1.21.1-adapter.2...v2.5.1-neoforge-1.21.1-adapter.1)

---

- Fixed SYNC `sync_offset` being applied around the wrong axes when the initial head pose changes. Rotation offsets now use head-local axes while retaining first-frame capture, subsequent head following and identity-offset behavior.
- Fixed LOCKED halos such as the bundled `mesh_demo` suddenly reversing around their normal during slow, tiny pitch changes near straight ahead and remaining reversed at rest. Polar offsets now use head-forward as their reference; the existing nonpolar orientation rules and damping are preserved.
- Changing the effective offset, orientation mode or `sync_offset` on resource reload now reinitializes motion on the next valid frame. Equipped halos and animation progress are retained; unrelated resource changes keep existing motion.
- Applied the shared orientation correction to world rendering and previews. Halo definitions, saves, network payloads and public API v2 remain compatible.
- Pinned HaloCore to **2.5.1 / 59e3bb2e** and restarted this core version's adapter revision at **1**. Players still install a single Halo JAR for **Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge**.
- All 347 core tests passed. This platform passed 129 automated adapter tests, with 1 explicitly skipped external-fixture check, plus all 15 targeted native singleplayer scenarios and its cloud build. Dedicated-server and third-party mod combinations were not revalidated in this round.

Requires **Java 21** or newer for **Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge**. Built and tested with NeoForge 21.1.248.

---

- 修复 SYNC 在不同初始头部姿态下将 `sync_offset` 应用到错误旋转轴的问题。偏移现按头部局部轴组合，保留首帧捕获、后续随头部旋转及单位偏移的既有语义。
- 修复内置 `mesh_demo` 等 LOCKED 光环在正视前方附近缓慢、小幅俯仰时突然沿法线反向，且静止后持续反向的问题。极点偏移改用头部前向作为参考，保留非极点朝向规则和原有阻尼。
- 资源重载改变有效定位偏移、朝向模式或 `sync_offset` 后，在下一有效帧重新初始化运动状态；保留佩戴关系与动画进度，无关资源变化继续保留原有运动状态。
- 世界渲染和预览共用修正后的朝向计算。既有光环定义、存档、网络载荷及公开 API v2 保持兼容。
- 固定 HaloCore **2.5.1 / 59e3bb2e**，并将该 core 版本的 adapter revision 从 **1** 重新开始。**Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge** 玩家仍只需安装一个 Halo JAR。
- core 的 347 项测试通过；本平台 129 项适配器自动测试、15 个原生单人专项场景及云端构建通过，另有 1 项外部测试包检查明确跳过。本轮未重新验收专用服及第三方模组组合。

**Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge** 需要 **Java 21** 或更高版本。本轮构建与游戏验证使用 NeoForge 21.1.248。
